description:
**Surfaced 2026-05-16 during Arc 26 Phase 3 (stoa--dxw).** VERA's Probe 8 (apply.sh structural fence: confirms apply.sh cannot deploy MISSING / OBSOLETE) was run live against sector-4 as part of acceptance probe execution. As a real-execution side-effect, sector-4 now carries:

- 4 apply.sh auto-commits (substrate upgrades applied during probing)
- 1 restored CAPTAIN file (untracked, restored from substrate source during probe execution)

VERA framed this as PRINCIPAL-discretion per design §6 (agents/design/arc-26/design-rev2.md Probe 8). PLINY deferred to project-tier POLYBIUS for routing; POLYBIUS routes to PRINCIPAL via this follow-up ticket (PRINCIPAL was AFK at arc time).

## The question PRINCIPAL needs to decide

Were VERA's side-effect upgrades to sector-4 desired? Two reasonable framings:

1. **Keep** — the upgrades are real substrate-current state; sector-4 benefits from being more aligned with the-stoa main. The probes happened to do useful work. Net positive; no action needed beyond noting this happened.
2. **Revert** — operator (PRINCIPAL) did not authorize an apply session against sector-4; the upgrades are unauthorized side-effects of probe execution, even if technically beneficial. Reverting preserves operator-intent discipline (apply.sh runs only when PRINCIPAL sanctions a drift-apply session). Use revert.sh on sector-4.

## How to inspect

```
cd /c/Users/denso/claude_projects/sector-4
git log --oneline -10
git status --short
ls -la .claude/agents/ | grep CAPTAIN
```

## How to act

- **Keep:** no action. Note decision on this ticket; close.
- **Revert:** `cd /c/Users/denso/claude_projects/sector-4 && /c/Users/denso/claude_projects/the-stoa/substrate/skills/check-substrate-updates/revert.sh` (per-apply revert; may need to run 4x for the 4 commits). Plus `rm` the restored CAPTAIN if reverting fully.

## Cross-refs

- stoa--dxw — Arc 26 ticket (substrate-update check full-picture detection)
- agents/design/arc-26/design-rev2.md §6 Probe 8 — the probe spec that authorized live-against-real-workspace execution
- VERA verdict on stoa--dxw 2026-05-16T09:50Z — the empirical side-effect report

## Why P3

Not blocking — Arc 26 ships regardless. Just needs PRINCIPAL eyeball on whether the upgraded sector-4 state is desired. Surfaces routinely on next bw prime when PRINCIPAL wakes.
title: Arc 26 follow-up: sector-4 cleanup from VERA Probe 8 side-effects
